text:
Duplicate of JMAP-x2gd.14 (8 *_READONLY string lists across handlers) which was already reclassified as workspace-canonical at JMAP-x2gd.87. The latter is human-labeled awaiting workspace-arch decision (option 1: trait method, option 2: proc-macro, option 3: separate patch type per data type).

When JMAP-x2gd.87 is resolved, the chosen mitigation will land across all 8 sites in chat-server plus the parallel sites in mail-server (and likely all 7 other extension-server siblings). Closing this bead as duplicate of the workspace-canonical sweep.
